sloka: तमुवाच महातेजा रामो राजर्षिसत्तम: ।किं मां भरत कुर्वाणं तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि ॥ २.१११.१६॥
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā rāmo rājarṣisattama: ।kiṁ māṁ bharata kurvāṇaṁ tāta pratyupavekṣyasi ॥ 2.111.16॥

translations.english: Rama, the foremost of royal sages and highly powerful said, 'Dear Bharata, what wrong have I done that you should prevent me by lying down in front of me?'
